{{Top|leg}}
'''House Renseth''' was a guild active in [[Depatar/Legends|Depatar]], a city of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Genarius]]. The [[permitor]] [[Maltok]] was affiliated to this house, apparently trying to direct costumers to business also affiliated to the house.

==Behind the scenes==
Maltok said he was "Grand Permitor of House Renseth", although the exact meaning of this utterance is unclear: Maltok could simply be bragging, House Renseth might have several people with that rank, or maybe Maltok did have special privileges.
